name: An audience without Varian

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic Alliance quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Baros’s report is delivered to Katrana Prestor because King Varian is away on diplomacy. The quest closes at this handoff and records a token of royal appreciation, but it does not answer what the report will change. The Keep’s pale stone, blue standards, and gold accents frame an unfinished political question; the story ends here without joining it to another conspiracy.
